Senses.Explanation: To turn the light back and reflect is an instruction or reflexive action directing illumination back upon oneself or one's stated understanding. The records also criticize people who use the four graphs as a label for quiet withdrawal, so the phrase is not defined as secluded quiet. Zibo Zhenke tells someone caught by disputation to turn the light back and reflect. Guishan Lingyou tells Yangshan Huiji to do so independently and immediately asks him to present his actual understanding, then tests each reply. Yuanwu Keqin says his listeners refuse to turn the light back and reflect before raising encounter records. Longqing Qingxian directs the action to one's own heels in a hall address. Zhongfeng Mingben elsewhere explicitly interrogates the four graphs and rejects calling secluded quiet by this name; the phrase therefore remains an attested reflexive instruction, not a quietist program.
